name: Services
description: Optional Windows services that many PCs never use.

tweaks.name: Disable Fax
tweaks.description: Only needed if you send or receive faxes through a modem connected to this PC.

tweaks.name: Disable Downloaded Maps Manager
tweaks.summary: Turns off the service for offline maps.
tweaks.description: Manages maps downloaded for offline use. Not needed once the Maps app is gone.

tweaks.name: Disable Retail Demo
tweaks.summary: Turns off the store demo mode service.
tweaks.description: Only used for PCs on display in shops.

tweaks.name: Disable Remote Registry
tweaks.summary: Stops other computers editing this PC's registry.
tweaks.description: Lets users on other computers change the registry on this PC. Disabled by default on most PCs, and safer that way.

tweaks.name: Disable Windows Media Player network sharing
tweaks.summary: Turns off media sharing from Windows Media Player Legacy.
tweaks.description: Shares your media library with other devices on the network through Windows Media Player Legacy.

tweaks.name: Disable Diagnostics Hub collector
tweaks.summary: Turns off a diagnostics collector used by developer tools.
tweaks.description: Collects real-time diagnostic events for Visual Studio and other developer tools. Leave on if you profile apps.

tweaks.name: Disable Distributed Link Tracking Client
tweaks.summary: Turns off tracking of moved files on network drives.
tweaks.description: Keeps shortcuts working when linked files move between NTFS drives on a network. Rarely needed at home.

tweaks.name: Disable Windows Insider service
tweaks.summary: Turns off the Windows Insider Program service.
tweaks.description: Only needed if you take part in the Windows Insider Program for preview builds.

tweaks.name: Disable Geolocation service
tweaks.summary: Turns off location for all apps.
tweaks.description: Finds this PC's location for apps such as Weather and Maps, and for Find my device. With it off, no app can get your location.

tweaks.name: Disable Windows Error Reporting service
tweaks.summary: Turns off the service that sends crash reports.
tweaks.description: Sends reports about crashes to Microsoft and checks for solutions. With it off, crash reports are not sent and you will not get suggested fixes.

tweaks.name: Disable Phone Service
tweaks.summary: Turns off telephony state for apps.
tweaks.description: Manages phone state on the device. Used by Phone Link for calls.

tweaks.name: Disable SysMain (Superfetch)
tweaks.summary: Stops Windows preloading apps into memory.
tweaks.description: SysMain learns which apps you use and preloads them into memory. On fast SSDs the gain is small. On hard drives apps may start slower without it.

tweaks.name: Disable Xbox services
tweaks.summary: Turns off Xbox sign-in, cloud saves and networking.
tweaks.description: Turns off Xbox Live Auth Manager, Xbox Live Game Save and Xbox Live Networking Service. Games that use Xbox sign-in or cloud saves will not work. Controllers keep working.

tweaks.name: Disable Windows Search indexing
tweaks.description: The indexer keeps a fast search index of your files and email. Without it, searches in Start, File Explorer and Outlook are slower and less complete.

tweaks.name: Disable Print Spooler
tweaks.description: Needed for every kind of printing, including Print to PDF. Only turn this off if you never print.

tweaks.name: Disable Windows Biometric Service
tweaks.summary: Turns off fingerprint and face sign-in.
tweaks.description: Needed for Windows Hello fingerprint and face sign-in. PIN and password sign-in keep working.
